channel.title: Sigillum of Notarization
channel.itunes:author: Derrick Spruill
channel.description:
Every signature tells a story. Some are bound by trust; others are forged in deception.

Welcome to Sigillum of Notarization, the dark-cinema audio drama anthology that plunges into the high-stakes psychology, hidden pressures, and statutory guardianship behind the notary seal. Written and created by Derrick Spruill and produced by Magnificent Workz and LearnWorkz, this five-book intertwined collection—Book I: The Psychology of Notarization, Book II: The Architecture of Consent, Book III: The Anatomy of Guardianship, Book IV: The Anatomy of Duty, and Book V: The Limits of Certification—brings a rotating ensemble of twenty hosts and dramatic narrators to the front lines of high-tension real estate closings, contested hospital-bed wills, elder financial defense, and covert corporate affidavits.

Listen to our two free official trailers, and subscribe on Apple Podcasts to unlock all 200 subscriber-only drama episodes across Books I–V.

Official Series Trailer: Behind the Brass Seal

Step behind the brass seal in the official series trailer for Sigillum of Notarization—the five-book dark-cinema audio drama anthology written and created by Derrick Spruill and produced by Magnificent Workz and LearnWorkz. From rain-lashed hospital rooms in Richmond to thirty-eighth-floor corner boardrooms in Charlotte, discover what happens when coercion, cognitive bias, and statutory guardianship collide at the signing table. item.itunes:title: The Guardians at the Table (Characters & Chronicles Trailer)
item.description:
Characters & Chronicles Trailer: The Guardians at the Table

Meet the recurring commissioned guardians whose intertwined refusal logs expose a sprawling network of coercion and title fraud across all five books of Sigillum of Notarization: Sarah Mercer in Richmond, David Mercer and Helena Bancroft in Old Town Alexandria, Hannah Okafor in Fairfax, Simone Bellamy and Kenneth Okafor in Charlotte, Mateo Delgado in Falls Church, Tessa Carmichael in Charlottesville, and Tariq Al-Mansoor in Washington, D.C. Subscribe on Apple Podcasts to unlock the entire subscriber-only anthology.
